content.what_it_is: MATLAB analysis/plot script for the FUNWAVE-TVD multi_vessel_morphology case (vessel-induced sediment transport). Loads dep_00000 from an external results drive (L3, L6) and mirrors the half-domain about the symmetry axis: N=2*n-1 (L9), DEP(1:n,:)=dep, DEP(n+1:end,:)=dep(n-1:-1:1,:) (L35-L36); dx=dy=1.0 (L12-L13). For snapshot nfile=[120] (L20; alternative [40 80 120] commented L19, labels mint L21), loads eta_, mask_, sediment concentration C_, suspended-load bed change DchgS_ and bed-load bed change DchgB_ (L43-L48), masks dry cells (L51-L52), mirrors all fields (L55-L64), and sums total bed change BB=BEDS+BEDB (L66). Plots 4 stacked panels via tight_subplot (L38) with axis window ax=[0 4500 0 120] (L39): (1) log10 of concentration converted to mg/L by CH*2680*1000.0 (L87, caxis [0 2.999] L88, colorbar label 'log10(C) (mg/L)' L92); (2) contourf of dZ_sus (L99, caxis +/-0.002 L105); (3) contourf of dZ_bed (L110, caxis +/-0.002 L115); (4) contourf of dZ_tot (L121, caxis +/-0.002 L126); colormap jet(12) (L133). A previously used eta panel is commented out (L68-L83). Then a second figure (L141-L165): laterally averaged bed change B(j)=mean(BB(j,:)) (L143-L145), max/min envelope of ETA along x (L147-L148), subplot(211) plots B vs y with axis [0 120 -0.004 0.002] (L150-L155), subplot(212) plots the initial depth profile -DEP(:,1), a dashed still-water line between y=15.7 and 102.32, and the MaxH/MinH eta envelopes (L156-L165).

equations.ref: total bed change = suspended + bed load
concentration to mg/L (2680 kg/m^3 sediment density scale) then log10

calls: tight_subplot L38 (external helper, not a MATLAB builtin)
unresolved: the factor 2680*1000.0 (L87) converts volumetric concentration to mg/L assuming sediment density 2680 kg/m^3; this provenance is not stated in the file
tight_subplot (L38) is a third-party helper that must exist on the MATLAB path; not shipped in this directory as far as this file shows
mirroring uses dep(n-1:-1:1,:) (L36) so row n is the symmetry axis and appears once; consistency with the model's half-domain symmetry boundary cannot be verified here
the still-water-line x-extent [15.7 102.32] (L159) is hard-coded; its derivation from the channel geometry is not in the file
mint labels (L21) correspond to the commented 3-snapshot set (L19); with nfile=[120] the title lines using mint are also commented (L75, L90)
DEP mirrored array is used only for the profile plot -DEP(:,1) (L157); mask uses threshold mask<1 (L51-L52) rather than mask==0 as in sibling scripts
